name: Hammered Hulls
label: Dischord
lede: The kid from the cover of Minor Threat's first record, the guitarist from Helium on bass, and two DC road dogs, making what may be the last record ever finished at Inner Ear.

eras.title: Four lifers, one new band
eras.text: Every member of Hammered Hulls had decades of bands behind them, and Dischord dates the group to 2018. The Washington Post was calling it a post-punk supergroup within months of the first show.

years.h: Alec MacKaye, Mary Timony, Mark Cisneros and Chris Wilson form a band
years.p: [[Alec MacKaye|bb05a948-ea44-4c9b-9d19-2a48f757ca22]] of [[Faith|f735a867-9a16-451f-8f83-669ed42e2574]] and [[Ignition|3cb2b7d6-1f0b-4ac5-b67f-52132f3d3b61]] sings. [[Mary Timony|d9c8dc3c-15b8-40d5-8153-ae9214aeef55]] of [[Helium|573510d6-bb5d-4d07-b0aa-ea6afe39e28d]] and [[Ex Hex|2f64e1fd-44b3-44f1-a586-b9916966b39f]] plays bass. [[Mark Cisneros|78448563-93ad-4d49-be7f-95bf5fe60021]] of [[Medications|c545a7bf-c8d7-4368-8009-22e19d8911ce]] plays guitar, and Chris Wilson of [[Titus Andronicus|d38c47f6-d9bb-4a77-aaea-df53a6616a68]] drums.
years.xp: The full résumés run longer. Alec MacKaye also sang in [[The Untouchables|16d88df0-a2a9-4b3b-87ff-84e90e312d40]] and [[The Warmers|af0dea4e-c501-47f2-8695-129f254d425f]]. Mary Timony had fronted Helium and Ex Hex on guitar, so bass was a switch. Mark Cisneros played in [[Deathfix|db0e5c06-c091-46d4-bd42-5ba2ee299123]] and [[Des Demonas|7536e54b-aa8f-429a-aa62-21184a53c14c]] as well, and Chris Wilson drummed for Ted Leo and the Pharmacists before Titus Andronicus.

q: Our songs started out punk, straight ahead, super Black Flag.
years.h: Hammered Hulls play their first show
years.p: Hammered Hulls play live for the first time in September. By December the Washington Post is writing them up as a post-punk supergroup.
years.xp:
The Post piece, headlined as eavesdropping on the new post-punk supergroup, caught a band whose songs were already changing shape. Mary Timony said they'd started out straight-ahead punk and were getting more complicated, more proggy.

Alec MacKaye described the songs as seeming to assemble themselves as the band worked.

eras.title: Three songs in one day
eras.text: Hammered Hulls went into Inner Ear with Don Zientara and Ian MacKaye, the studio Dischord has leaned on since the early '80s, and came out with a 7" in a single day. It put the band on Dischord and on the road.

years.p: Three songs, Written Words, Self Inflicted and Looking After You, recorded in a day at Inner Ear Studios with [[Don Zientara|a495882b-4585-4295-9269-e30c63f279fe]] and [[Ian MacKaye|c12f644b-1066-4ead-b0dd-d0c380f5cca2]], Alec's older brother.
years.xp: Stereogum premiered Written Words on July 16, and asked about the name, Alec MacKaye feverishly built an explanation on the spot. The 7" came on mixed-color vinyl, with East Coast shows to follow.

years.h: Hammered Hulls play Baltimore, then New York
years.p: Out-of-town shows follow the 7": Baltimore on August 28, New York on August 29.

eras.title: The last record at Inner Ear
eras.text: The band started its album before the pandemic shut everything down and finished it in the second half of 2021. Dischord says it may be the last record recorded and mixed at Inner Ear, the studio behind most of the label's history.

years.h: Hammered Hulls finish Careening at Inner Ear
years.p: Started at Inner Ear just before the pandemic lockdown, Careening is finished there in summer and fall 2021, engineered by Don Zientara and produced by Ian MacKaye. Dischord says it may be the last record made at the studio.
years.xp:
Inner Ear, Don Zientara's studio, had recorded Dischord bands since the label's earliest days. For the Hulls, the sessions bridged the whole pandemic.

Dischord describes the result as vulnerable songs, only barely contained, with strong contributions from each member.

years.p: Hammered Hulls' debut album: twelve songs on white vinyl, from Boilermaker's Notch and Bog People to Mission Statement.
years.xp: Brooklyn Vegan and Stereogum premiered Rights and Reproduction ahead of release. Written Word returned from the 2019 7", and shows followed through the fall and winter.

years.p: According to Discogs, the Hammered Hulls LP goes back to press on blue vinyl. Dischord's band page lists the band as active and on tour.
